title: Correct horizontal motion
description: Essential: Student correctly applies uniform linear motion to relate horizontal displacement R to initial velocity v₀ and flight time t.

title: Correct vertical motion
description: Essential: Student correctly applies free-fall kinematics to relate height h to gravitational acceleration g and flight time t.

title: Final velocity condition
description: Essential: Student derives and presents the final condition v₀ = R√(g/(2h)) from combining horizontal and vertical motion equations.

title: Angular displacement condition
description: Important: Student recognizes that the disk must rotate by an integer multiple of 2π during the flight time for the ball to land at point B.

title: Final angular velocity condition
description: Essential: Student derives and presents the final condition ω = 2nπ√(g/(2h)) with n = 0,1,2,... from combining angular motion with flight time.

title: Integer multiple recognition
description: Important: Student explicitly states or correctly uses that n must be a non-negative integer (n = 0,1,2,...) in the angular velocity solution.

title: Sign or direction errors
description: Pitfall: Student incorrectly uses signs for gravitational acceleration or misinterprets direction of motion.

title: Missing integer condition
description: Pitfall: Student omits the integer multiple condition (n = 0,1,2,...) in the angular velocity solution.
